description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取国证（cni）行业分类在指定日期的成分股列表。可按行业代码批量查询获取指定时间样本信息，返回信息包括每只成分股的代码、地区和市场信息。当用户需要查看国证行业成分股列表、获取成分股清单或确认股票在国证体系下的行业分类时，调用此接口。
description.en: Fetch CSI (cni) industry classification constituent list at a specified date, returning constituent stock code, area code, and market. Supports single or multiple industry codes. Date can be specific or 'latest'. Used when user needs to view CSI (cni) industry constituents, retrieve constituent lists, or confirm a stock's classification under the CSI system.
